arStrings.szText:
Shapeshifting into a new animal form causes a {c_important}Lightning Bolt{/c} to strike a Nearby enemy dealing {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * (1 + Owner.Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus) * Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Lightning damage.

Your {c_important}Lightning Bolts{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage and Stun for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
